anatomic_site_tumor: Pre-treatment prostate cancer samples and BPH control samples were collected immediately following digital rectal examination (DRE), which was performed as 3 finger strokes per prostate lobe.
disease_state: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).
material_type: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
